description: Synthetic grounded-QA cases layered on the shared retrieval_v1 baseline documents (evals/datasets/retrieval_v1.json). Recorded, hand-authored expected generation outputs; no real LLM call is ever made. Includes answered single-citation, multi-page-section citation, insufficient-evidence, an intentionally invalid citation (to exercise the invalid-citation-rate metric), and the prompt-injection-as-inert-data case.
